about_the_game:
DOTScape is a fast-paced multiplayer action game where you become a simple dot in a chaotic world of obstacles, buttons, and competitive challenges. Designed for quick matches and endless replayability, it’s all about timing, reactions, and outsmarting your friends.


Run through levels filled with obstacles, activate buttons to progress, and adapt to dynamic environments that keep every round fresh. And when it’s time for a break from the main levels, jump into chaotic minigames to prove your skills in unique, bite-sized challenges.


Up to 8 players can join a lobby – work together or compete against each other, but only the fastest and smartest dots will rise to the top.

✨ Features

• 🎯 Fast-paced levels: Overcome traps, dodge hazards, and hit buttons to advance.
• 🤝 Multiplayer chaos: Play online with up to 8 players – friends or rivals.
• 🎲 Chaotic minigames: Compete in quick-fire challenges between levels.
• 🔁 Replayable fun: Every session is different, keeping the action fresh.
• 🎨 Minimalist style: A clean visual design that keeps the focus on speed and gameplay.


Whether you’re racing through tricky stages, pushing your luck in minigames, or simply trying to survive the chaos, DOTScape delivers a unique blend of speed, simplicity, and multiplayer madness.


Ready to escape into the dotscape?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-8100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti / AMD RX 560
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-12400F / AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060 Ti / AMD RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

short_description: DOTScape is a fast-paced multiplayer action game where you play as a dot, overcome obstacles, hit buttons in levels, and compete in chaotic minigames with up to 7 other players.
